name: wallet-oracle-fork
description: The wallet oracle (rig/WALLET-ORACLE.md) across a fork switch, every node on this role's jar: the subject wallet follows a losing branch (its own payment confirmed there, rewards maturing there) and rolls back to the heavier chain at the heal; it is then compared field by field with a reference wallet with the same keys that never saw the losing branch. WO_EVENTS: fork (the switch), none (no cut: A/A), rescan-from (fork + positive control). Needs netem. Expectation, the before/after shape: the base shows a wallet difference in at least one run, the candidate in none. A PR that should not change the wallet reads as NULL with both roles same.
